All work is complete and verified. Summary of the implementation:

**Problem**: `CustomerService.customerCommunicationSystem` (the in-process bus) published `EMAIL` events, but nothing was subscribed to the channel, so no mail ever reached the provider (SES).

**Changes**:

1. **`src/utils/aws/ses.ts`** (new) — SES client (picks up `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`/region from the env like other repo clients) plus the wire framing recorded in `/opt/meteringco-mail-sandbox/dispatch-capture`:
   - `Source`: RFC 2047 base64 encoded word for the display name, always emitted (`=?UTF-8?B?…?= <from@…>`, `=?UTF-8?B??= <…>` when the name is empty)
   - `Destination.ToAddresses`: exactly the one `toEmail` (no cc/bcc, no fallback)
   - `ReplyToAddresses`: `Name <address>` unencoded
   - `Subject` and body with `Charset: UTF-8`, `Html` part when `html` is truthy, otherwise `Text`
   - `ConfigurationSetName: defaultConfigurationSet`

2. **`src/customer/entities/customerCommunication.entity.ts`** — new `EmailCustomerCommunicationProcessor`: one published event → one message addressed to the customer it names; events carrying no email send nothing; provider refusals (unverified sender / suppressed recipient) are logged and audited via `AuditService` and swallowed so later communications still go out; deliveries are chained to preserve publish order; listener invocation is bound safely and `listenerCount` exposed.

3. **`src/customer/customer.service.ts` / `customer.module.ts`** — idempotent `subscribeForCustomerCommunicationEvents()` registration (guarded so the double module init of public/private customer modules can't double-send), also invoked on module load so the mail path is live for any consumer of the bus.

4. **`src/customer/entities/customerCommunication.entity.spec.ts`** (new) — unit tests for the framing, single recipient, empty event and continue-after-refusal behaviour.

**Verification**: replaying `communication-events.jsonl` through the bus produced exactly 7 messages whose outbox records match `ses-outbox.jsonl` field-for-field (envelope, headers, config set, body parts/charsets); the two refused events and the empty event put nothing on the wire and didn't stop later sends. Full unit suite (55 suites / 287 tests) plus the new spec pass, and lint/prettier are clean.
